comments.text:
India is not only about Mumbai’s crowds, water issues, or garbage problems. Mumbai is just one part of a huge and incredibly diverse country.
I would love to see you explore more of India—each state and Union Territory—with its different cultures, languages, religions, traditions, landscapes, and ways of living. The living conditions and experiences can be very different from one region to another.
India is a vast country with so much diversity and many stories that the world rarely gets to see. Next time, please travel beyond Mumbai and explore different parts of the country. Show the world India as a whole, not just one city or one side of it. 🇮🇳
